source_refs.note: 'Null Hypothesis (H0)' under topic 7.2, as printed (PDF 94, printed 90).

blocks.text: The null hypothesis states that there is no effect or difference. It is written as a default assumption. Data is tested against this hypothesis. If evidence is strong, the null hypothesis is rejected. It is usually represented by H₀. The null hypothesis helps avoid bias. It provides a comparison base. Many tests start with this hypothesis. It is important in decision-making.
